title: Report link
text: If this link is being abused or you did not expect it, you can report it here. The secret is deleted without anyone reading it.
done: Done. The secret has been deleted.

errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.gone: This link does not exist (any more). There is nothing to report.
errors.goneOpened: This link has already been opened and the secret is deleted. There is nothing left to report. If you did not open it yourself, tell the sender.
errors.goneExpired: This link has expired and the secret was deleted. There is nothing to report.
errors.goneReported: This link has already been reported and the secret was deleted.
errors.goneRevoked: The sender withdrew this link and the secret was deleted. There is nothing to report.
